Package net.murat.uikit

Class MFilePicker

java.lang.Object
net.murat.uikit.MFilePicker
public class MFilePicker extends Object
MFilePicker is a lightweight, customizable file picker for Android (API 29+). It features multi-selection support, fluent MIME type filtering, and direct lifecycle bridging.

      Appends a single MIME type filter to the existing configuration list. Handles wildcard overrides intelligently without clearing valid states.

      Returns:
      This instance for method chaining.

    • handleResult

      public boolean handleResult(int requestCode, int resultCode, android.content.Intent data)
      Bridges the host Activity's onActivityResult data into the library state. Handles both single selection (getData) and multi-selection (getClipData).
      Parameters:
      requestCode - The request code passed to startActivityForResult.
      resultCode - The result code returned by the child activity.
      data - The Intent carrying the result URI payload.
      Returns:
      True if one or more valid Uris were successfully captured.

    • getSelectedUri

      public android.net.Uri getSelectedUri()
      Returns the primary selected Uri (first item in multi-selection).
      Returns:
      The selected content Uri, or null if nothing was selected.

    • getSelectedUris

      public List<android.net.Uri> getSelectedUris()
      Returns all selected Uris during a multi-selection operation.
      Returns:
      List of selected content Uris, or an empty list if nothing was selected.

    • getSelectedInputStream

      public InputStream getSelectedInputStream() throws FileNotFoundException
      Opens an InputStream for the primary selected file via ContentResolver. This is the correct approach for content:// Uris on API 29+.
      Returns:
      InputStream for the selected file.
      Throws:
      FileNotFoundException - if no file is selected or the Uri cannot be opened.

    • getInputStreamForUri

      public InputStream getInputStreamForUri(android.net.Uri uri) throws FileNotFoundException
      Opens an InputStream for any given Uri via ContentResolver. Useful for iterating over multi-selection results manually.
      Parameters:
      uri - The content Uri to open.
      Returns:
      InputStream for the given Uri.
      Throws:
      FileNotFoundException - if the Uri cannot be opened.
